comments.comment: If Black closes the centre with ...c4 while the king is still on e8, the bishop drops to b1 here, not c2. On b1 it shuts the first rank, and that decides the a-file fight after ...Bxb5 axb5 Nc7 b6: if Black takes on b6, Bxc7 wins, because ...Rxa1 no longer hits our queen. (8... c4 9. Bb1 Bxb5 10. axb5 Nc7 11. b6 axb6 12. Bxc7)
